部品の少なさではなく、最初の細密Cの顔・体形・丸みへの近さを優先しました。本人の: Priority is resemblance to the initial fine C face, proportions and roundness, not minimizing pieces. User visual approval is still required.
形比較は4モデルを同じ画面上高さへ正規化。実寸比ではありません。実寸比較だけ同じ: Shape panels normalize all 4 models to equal screen height. They are not size-ratio images. Only the separate physical-size image uses identical px/mm.
層数は組付け部品の底面Z位置の数です。3.2mmはプレートの本体高さで、FDMの: Layer counts refer to distinct assembly bottom-Z positions.3.2mm is the plate body height, not an FDM slicing layer height.
実assembly instance数。内部/基礎を含み、仮支持台2個・背景は除: Actual assembly instances including foundation and internal parts; excludes 2 temporary pedestals and the stage. Not sampled-cell, type or vertex counts.
8mmXYの段差・ブロック境界・直径4.8mm／高さ1.8mmのスタッドは残り、: The 8 mm XY steps, brick seams and 4.8 mm diameter / 1.8 mm tall studs remain; this is not the continuous original surface.
約36cmの完成品と10,908個の組立は大きな作業負担です。部品数だけで美観/: A roughly 36 cm figure with 10,908 separately assembled parts is a substantial undertaking. Count alone proves neither likeness, handling nor strength.
ひげ先端のため2つの仮支持台が必要。実保持力確認前に取り除かず、大きい完成品の荷: Two temporary whisker pedestals are required. Do not remove before actual retention checks; whole-figure loads, tipping and friction are untested.
元の3MF印刷寸法の原型、初期Cの目標尺度、正規化画面上の倍率は別物です。r2一: Original 3MF print size, initial C target scale and on-screen normalization are distinct. No single-body r2 print data is created.
新パイロットは現行r3より、初期Cの丸い頬・頭部、左右の目、口・耳・ひげに近い細: Compared with current r3, the new pilot has finer stepping around the rounded head/cheeks, eyes, mouth, ears and whiskers, closer to the initial fine-C reference.
最初のレンダーで口元に紫の切れが見えました。原3MFの正面可視面をrayで調べ、: The first rendered smile contained purple interruptions. Actual front rays against the painted original3MF identified three cells where nearest-point sampling had selected an unpainted recess instead of the visible black smile.
他の可視セルを持たない3つの既存部品を、実際の元三角形の黒へ変更して再描画しまし: Three existing whole parts with only those exposed cells were recolored to the verified source black and rendered again. Piece counts, IDs, geometry and interfaces did not change; no invented face decoration was added.
修正後の口は黒い段階的な笑みとして読めますが、連続した原型曲線と完全一致するわけ: The corrected black stepped smile is readable, but it is not identical to the original continuous curve.
額・目・頬のプレート段差、露出スタッド、平らな色面は残ります。原型の連続曲面や本: Forehead/eye/cheek plate steps, exposed studs and planar color regions remain. Neither continuous-surface equivalence nor the user's likeness approval is claimed.
新案の額と鼻の間の大きい同色面、目の白い縁、細い段階的な口元は初期Cと同一ではあ: The larger same-color forehead/nose region, white eye rims and thin stepped smile are not identical to initial C. The face crop exposes rather than hides those differences.
大きさだけで改善を演出しないよう、形比較の4体は投影上の画面高さを揃えています。: The four shape panels use equal actual projected screen height. The18cm/36cm physical-size comparison is separate.
